# Fun Shapes: Hollow Square
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_3.hollow_square
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model
{
   x ~ dunif(-1, 1)
   y ~ dunif(-1, 1)
   O <- 0
   O ~ dbern(constraint)
   constraint <- (step(0.5 - abs(x)) * step(0.50 - abs(y)))
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
